question: Under an owner-approved profile, does this exact ControllerProbe build observe RC-N3 accessory visibility, advertised protocols, at most one session, input-stream state and successful reads within 60 seconds, separately in five COLD runs without DJI Fly and five PRIMED runs, with no application-level writes?
build_commands: Review apps/ios/ControllerProbe/README.md, apps/ios/ControllerProbe/build-device.sh and Sources/MSDKIOSAppleTransport at this commit.
Copy apps/ios/ControllerProbe/Config/Local.xcconfig.example to Local.xcconfig and privately set the team, bundle identifier and the owner-approved profile.
apps/ios/ControllerProbe/build-device.sh (prints the Xcode version, source SHA and executable SHA-256).
xcrun devicectl device install app --device <device-id> <app path printed by build-device.sh>
procedure: H0: install the BLOCKED default build and confirm Activation shows BLOCKED: PROFILE_BLOCKED with Start disabled.
Record privately: iOS version and build, Xcode version, signing team type, cable, RC-N3 and Mini 4 Pro firmware, DJI Fly version.
Record the owner's permission decision, set the approved profile in Local.xcconfig and rebuild; record the new executable SHA-256.
Bench: propellers removed, operator present, phone unlocked and in the foreground, RC-N3 cable connected for all ten runs.
COLD runs 1-5: power-cycle the RC-N3 and aircraft without launching DJI Fly in that boot sequence; wait 30 s; launch ControllerProbe fresh; choose Cold; tap Start.

PRIMED runs 1-5, after all COLD runs: power-cycle; use DJI Fly until it shows the aircraft connected; terminate Fly from the app switcher; wait 10 s; launch ControllerProbe fresh; choose Primed; tap Start.
After each run, copy the run record into that run's private record and force-quit ControllerProbe.
If DJI Fly launches during a COLD run, record that run as INCOMPLETE (primed), not COLD.
Keep all records private until publication is decided; share only owner-approved counts and timings.
expected_outcomes: Each run record names the source SHA, activation, cohort, end reason and cleanup time, with every readiness value UNKNOWN.
Layers L1-L5 (accessory visible, protocols advertised, session created, input open, first successful read) are reported separately with times; output stays NOT_REQUESTED and no write is attempted.
A COLD cohort that reaches L5 is a transport GO candidate only; L5 in the PRIMED cohort alone keeps independent initialization blocked.
No result establishes controller meaning, aircraft communication, telemetry validity or any command capability.
stop_conditions: Any motor or propeller activity, or a controller or aircraft state or mode change.
An unexpected iOS prompt, pairing or permission request, or a probe crash.
A WRITE_ATTEMPT_BLOCKED or OUTPUT_STREAM_ACTIVITY flag in a run record.
A thermal or low-battery warning, or unstable power.

prerequisites.requirement: Owner decision on using the selected accessory protocol in a non-distributed development build, and on publishing run results
Owner-selected profile (ENUMERATION_ONLY or SESSION_OBSERVATION) and, for a session, the single protocol name
H0 Mac compilation, signing and installation of this exact commit
Private inventory: iOS build, firmware versions, cable and DJI Fly version
Bench safety: propellers removed and operator present
